releaseNotes: Discussion Input Fix: Comment input bar and typed text are fully visible above the keyboard with auto-scroll and quick jump to discussion
In-App Staff Creation: Super Admin, GM, and Dept Managers can create user/staff accounts directly within the mobile app
Multi-Format Work Proof: Full support for attaching and opening PDF documents (.pdf) and Excel spreadsheets (.xlsx, .xls, .csv)
Instant Live Sync: Automated background auto-fetch every 6–8s and foreground app resume sync across app and web portal
